stem: A pH meter gives a sudden unexpected value after it was stored incorrectly. What should the technician do before making a large solution adjustment?
choices: Assume the reading is correct and add more acid or base
Check probe condition and calibrate/verify the meter according to procedure, then repeat the measurement
Average the value with yesterday's result
Record the expected value instead of the measured value
rationale: Poor meter storage or calibration can create measurement error. Verification should occur before using a suspicious reading to make a major chemistry change.
